reviews.comment:
- Passive-aggressive demeanor

- Dismissive towards student queries

- Harsher grading for ESL students

- Class time spent on self-promotion, not academic content

- Lacks understanding and empathy

- Divisive views on TAMU's education quality

- Selective in offering office hours

This class is not easy, however very doable. if you want to do well: go to class. actually listen. make sure your questions are asked. take notes. There's 4 exams. the questions are t/f but you don't get a lot of time to answer them, which is why its important you know the material. Prof. B answers questions and is easy to get ahold of.

Bad. Lectures consisted of 50+ white slides with paragraphs of text, no visual aids, and little room for productive discussion. Only graded on once-weekly homework and 2 exams. Says to know everything on the Quizlet (70+ terms) by the end of each week. Too much information imparted. Did give an extra cred book report. Know what you're getting into!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I have ever had. She is passive aggressive, rude and will make you feel belittled. Her lectures consisted of reading power point slides word for word. Her tests and instructions are completely riddled with spelling and grammar mistakes to the point where you often times can't understand them.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: 5 thought questions (pass/fail) & 6 25-question exams. I made A's on all exams except the final. I failed miserably & was shocked. She later sent an email saying she misgraded our FINAL exam. She required us to go & regrade our own exams. Thought this was very unfair. Easy class but double check all your exams after she grades them for any errors

I am surprised at how low Prof. Braman's score is. I took an online comm 320 course with her this semester and it has been great! Very clear criteria for assignments, and as long as you are prepared her exams are not too bad. She also is very accommodating and willing to work with her students and gives chances to complete assignments for credit
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I saw how low Professor Braman's score was on here and I was very surprised. This is a tough class, but I can tell she enjoys teaching us and has our best interests at heart. There is a lot of class discussion, so do your reading ahead of time so you don't get called out unprepared. Overall, a manageable class if you put in the bare minimum effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the RUDEST, most demeaning, professor I have ever had. Don't attempt to ask her questions because she thinks all questions are stupid. She is unorganized and is defensive if you try to correct her. She isn't helpful at all. STEER CLEAR OF HER.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She puts in the wrong grade on canvas for you? Forget it, she's not fixing it. Oh, you don't know how to calculate your grade because this class is so disorganized? Well, you're SOL. But by all means, take this class if you want a demeaning and rude professor.

Avoid at all costs! Professor Braman is one of the most inconsiderate professors I have encountered. She makes her students feel stupid and is not helpful at all when approached with questions. Often times, she grades with her own ideologies and will give 0s if your views do not match hers. I wish I would have avoided this class.

This professor was absolutely horrendous. One of the worst professors I have ever experienced at Texas A&M. When my assignments were graded incorrectly I had a meeting with Professor Braman. She was inconsiderate and rude. She told me to look back over the syllabus because I was wrong and wouldnt hear me out on what my issue was. And unorganized.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I have ever had. Not only is she unorganized, she refuses to pass you on anything and is 0 help when questions are asked. She is rude and mean to her students and dismisses any questions about the course or grades. She does not care about her students. Her grades on canvas are incorrect and she refuses to correct them.

I have never made a rating for a professor but as this is my last semester and possibly one of the WORST professors I have ever had, I couldn't not say something. Sandra Braman is quite possibly the most boring, conceded, and unorganized professor. Essay prompts are confusing and she makes you feel like an idiot if you ask for help. STEER CLEAR!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: STAY AWAY!!! I am not one to give reviews about a teachers especially bad reviews. However, this prof has unrealistic expectations. Her grading policies are very unfair and inconsistent! When you ask her questions she makes you feel dumb. Doesnt have problem failing you!

You can get an A easily. However, this is one of the worst professors at A&M. She is one of the most boring, unenthusiastic, uninteresting, lazy professors on the planet. She reads from black and white slides for her lectures. I'd recommend going to class for the points, which is legit the only reason people go.

Overall the course was really great. Lectures were good, discussion is encouraged and often interesting. Exams are online, taken anywhere, 24hour time frame. The professor knows her stuff and takes answering students questions seriously. However, her directions for papers/extra credit are vague. 200 study question per exam that need to be answered
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: STAY AWAY! unfortunately this class is mandatory for most, but if there is anyone other prof to take this class from, steer clear of sandra! She had unrealistic expectations, low standards of us as students from the beginning, and constantly had to change things up (tests, lectures, papers) because she was so unorganized. treated us like idiots

Not to be dramatic, but this was the worst class I have ever take. Dr. Braman is ridiculous and treated us so unfairly. The grading criteria and assignments were extremely unclear and she changed things on us all the time. She was rude and destroyed us if we asked questions she deemed "dumb." Would not wish this on anyway. Steer clear.

Professor is very knowledgable and intelligent. She offered three different extra credit opportunities, even though all quizzes are available for multiple unlimited retakes already. I find the content of the course interesting and straightforward. With the online textbook, lectures, and PowerPoints combined, I did pretty well in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is really informational for the world we live in today. There are attendance points 5 online quizzes (which are really tests) that make up your grade. She gives you the study questions before to study and work on so it's helpful. However, for each quiz there's 200 questions that you must fill out to be prepared for the quiz.
